title: Land use for alcohol production and its implications for food security and public health: A case study of the United States
title_zh: 酒精生产的土地利用及其对粮食安全和公共健康的影响：以美国为例

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between functional specialization (FS) in global value chains (GVCs) and wages. Drawing on the GVC theory and intellectual monopoly capitalism theory, both highlighting asymmetries in international production and knowledge networks, it is postulated that FS in fabrication and FS in research and development (R&D) have differentiated effects on the evolution of wages. To test this hypothesis, we embed measures of FS in a structural wage regression and estimate the relationship for 25 EU countries over the period 2003–2022. We find some evidence for this hypothesis, notably a negative association between FS in fabrication and wages. Furthermore, we obtain partial confirmation of the expected patterns in our instrumental variable regressions, although the findings are not fully robust across all specifications.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球价值链（GVC）中的功能专业化（FS）与工资之间的关系。基于全球价值链理论与智力垄断资本主义理论（两者均强调国际生产与知识网络中的不对称性），本文提出假设：制造功能专业化与研发（R&D）功能专业化对工资演变具有差异化影响。为验证该假设，我们将功能专业化指标嵌入结构性工资回归模型，并对2003-2022年间25个欧盟国家进行估计。研究结果部分支持该假设，尤其发现制造功能专业化与工资呈负相关关系。此外，工具变量回归虽部分验证了预期模式，但该结论在所有模型设定中并非完全稳健。
title: Functional specialization and wages in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲的功能专业化与工资

abstract: Abstract We estimate the trade and income effects of regulatory developments concerning standard‐like non‐tariff measures (NTMs) over 2012–2017 combining structural gravity estimates and general equilibrium projections. The trade cost effects of regulatory changes vary at the country‐pair level and across sectors. Overall, NTM‐related regulatory changes over 2012–2017 increased trade costs in goods, which reduced global trade by 1.2%. The majority of this reduction corresponds to a decline in goods trade equivalent to about 40% of the actual worldwide decrease of nominal goods trade over this period. Yet the implied reduction of real income is small. We highlight significant variation of these effects at the country and sector level, and show that excluding pair‐specific trade frictions and third‐country effects introduces omitted variable bias. Our findings imply that advances in international coordination of technical regulation can further reduce trade frictions and enhance trade and real income.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文结合结构引力估计与一般均衡预测，评估了2012–2017年间标准类非关税措施监管变化对贸易和收入的影响。监管变化的贸易成本效应在国家-行业层面存在异质性。总体而言，2012–2017年间与非关税措施相关的监管变化提高了商品贸易成本，导致全球贸易下降1.2%。这一降幅中，大部分对应商品贸易的减少量，约占同期全球名义商品贸易实际下降幅度的40%。然而，由此导致的实际收入下降幅度较小。我们强调这些效应在国家与行业层面存在显著差异，并表明忽略国家-行业特定贸易摩擦及第三国效应会引入遗漏变量偏误。研究结果表明，技术监管国际协调的进展可进一步减少贸易摩擦，促进贸易与实际收入增长。
title: General equilibrium effects of technical non‐tariff measures: evidence from bilateral trade cost estimates
title_zh: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据

abstract: Abstract This paper examines the implications of the EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA) using a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model. Unlike previous studies that primarily projected potential impacts of Brexit based on uncertain scenarios, this analysis introduces new estimates of tariffs and non‐tariff measures specified by the TCA. The findings show that while the TCA will necessitate substantial adjustments for some sectors, Brexit will not fundamentally alter the overall structure of the UK economy. However, the main impacts will manifest as significant hits to real wages and productivity, exacerbating the long‐standing economic challenges faced by the UK.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文运用动态空间一般均衡模型，评估了欧盟-英国贸易与合作协定（TCA）的经济影响。与以往主要基于不确定情景预测英国脱欧潜在影响的研究不同，本文引入了TCA所规定的关税与非关税措施的最新估算。研究结果表明，尽管TCA将迫使部分行业进行重大调整，但英国脱欧并不会从根本上改变英国经济的整体结构。然而，其主要影响将体现为实际工资与生产率的显著下降，从而加剧英国长期面临的经济挑战。
title: Counting the costs: a quantitative assessment of the effects of Brexit on UK regions and sectors
title_zh: 量化成本：英国脱欧对英国各地区和行业影响的定量评估

abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the relationship between participation in the EU Rural Development Program and the economic performance of Italian olive farms using a finite‐mixture model with inverse‐probability‐weighted regression adjustment. Based on 2010–2022 FADN panel data, it estimates heterogeneous treatment effects while correcting for selection bias. Results suggest that RDP participation is associated with higher net income, by about EUR 280/ha on average. Two farm clusters emerge, also reflecting different typologies of rural development program measure packages: family‐run farms in disadvantaged areas are often associated with agro‐climatic environmental commitments and related packages and gain about €265/ha. By contrast, more profitable and labor‐intensive farms are more frequently linked to less adopted measures and benefit only marginally. A Monte Carlo simulation assesses the estimator's performance under a controlled data‐generating process. The study highlights the need to account for structural heterogeneity in policy evaluation and supports data‐driven rural development strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文采用有限混合模型与逆概率加权回归调整方法，探究欧盟农村发展计划参与对意大利橄榄农场经济绩效的影响。基于2010-2022年FADN面板数据，在纠正选择偏差的同时估计异质性处理效应。结果表明，参与农村发展计划与净收入提升相关，平均每公顷约增加280欧元。研究识别出两类农场集群，分别对应不同的农村发展计划措施组合类型：位于欠发达地区的家庭经营农场通常与农业气候环境承诺及相关措施包相关联，每公顷增收约265欧元；而利润更高、劳动密集型的农场则更多与采用率较低的措施相关，仅获得边际收益。通过蒙特卡洛模拟在受控数据生成过程中评估了估计量的表现。本研究强调政策评估中需考虑结构性异质性，并为数据驱动的农村发展战略提供支撑。
title:
Differentiated Impacts of
                    EU
                    Rural Development Measures: A Finite Mixture Evaluation of Italian Olive Farms
title_zh: 欧盟农村发展措施的差异化影响：意大利橄榄农场的有限混合评估

abstract: Land rights, important dimensions of land tenure, are crucial for smallholder farmers’ land tenure security and climate change adaptation. However, there are knowledge gaps on the nexus between land rights and climate adaptation in Ghana, particularly from a gendered perspective. This study draws on land right frameworks to explore the nexus between gender, land rights and climate change adaptation among men and women smallholder farmers in rural Ghana. Data were collected through a randomized survey administered to 510 smallholder farmers from four purposively selected communities in the Adansi Asokwa District, and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. The results showed that compared to women, more men own more farmlands (averagely 6.8 vs. 5.4 acres for women), have formal land title deeds, and exercise more land rights, particularly exclusion and alienation rights, enhancing their tenure security. Besides frequency of pest invasion, there is no significant differences in men’s and women’s climate change perceptions and experiences. Farmers used multiple climate adaptation strategies, including planting improved crop varieties, changing planting season, climate information services and agrochemical application. We found a significant difference between men’s and women’s adoption of crop diversification, crop-livestock integration and seed storage. Unlike men’s adaptation strategies, those of women are influenced by the number of rights they exercise and farmland size. Also, perceptions about the raining season and temperature intensity as well as marital status, locality, years of farming experience, access to non-farm livelihood activities and credit significantly influence farmers’ climate change adaptation. Gender differentiated policies and incentives for farmers are needed to enhance tenure security and climate change adaptation.
title: Gender, land rights and climate change adaptation in Ghana: Implications for land tenure, agriculture and rural development
title_zh: 加纳的性别、土地权利与气候变化适应：对土地权属、农业和农村发展的影响

abstract: Abstract Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.
abstract_zh: 摘要：市场能否对海外高成本不当行为形成约束？本文聚焦重大人权侵犯事件——具体而言，即采矿活动人士遇刺事件（此类情境下正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件通常不涉及交易对手方），探究市场惩罚机制。研究表明，媒体报道中涉及此类事件的企业会遭受显著且负面的异常股票收益。相较于企业不当行为相关反应可能具有短暂性或弱化特征，我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10日损失超过1亿美元。鉴于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们重点考察市场惩罚的作用机制。我们提出与声誉成本相一致的三种传导路径：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感型机构投资者在刺杀事件后系统性减持；（3）事件导致未来贸易减少，新合同签订量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。研究发现，刺杀事件与矿业特许权使用费依赖度呈正相关，表明即便面临市场压力，地方租金仍会维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁在制度薄弱环境中可能具有显著效力，但当地方与全球激励存在分歧时，未必能完全遏制不当行为。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理

abstract: Abstract Restrictive immigration policies can force organisations to alter their workforce composition, with unclear effects on organisational performance. We study the effects of the 2016 Brexit referendum, which reduced the share of EU-nationality nurses in English hospitals. Using administrative patient-level data and a continuous difference-in-differences design, exploiting hospitals’ pre-referendum exposure, we estimate the causal impact of a negative labour supply shock on care quality. Hospitals with higher pre-referendum EU nurse shares experienced higher post-referendum emergency patient mortality, equivalent to 1,238 additional deaths annually in the three years after the referendum. Consistent with theoretical predictions, hospitals responded to labour shortages by relaxing hiring standards: foreign nurses recruited after the referendum were appointed to lower salary grades, suggesting lower skills and experience.
abstract_zh: 限制性移民政策可能迫使组织改变其劳动力构成，但对组织绩效的影响尚不明确。我们以2016年英国脱欧公投为研究对象，该事件导致英格兰医院中欧盟籍护士比例下降。利用行政层面的患者数据以及连续双重差分设计，通过医院在公投前的暴露程度，我们估算了负向劳动力供给冲击对护理质量的因果影响。公投前欧盟护士比例较高的医院，在公投后急诊患者死亡率更高，相当于公投后三年内每年额外增加1,238例死亡。与理论预测一致，医院通过放宽招聘标准来应对劳动力短缺：公投后招聘的外籍护士被分配到较低薪资等级，表明其技能和经验水平较低。
title: Immigration, Workforce Composition, and Organisational Performance: The Effect of Brexit on NHS Hospital Quality
title_zh: 移民、劳动力构成与组织绩效：英国脱欧对NHS医院质量的影响

abstract: Abstract Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.
abstract_zh: 摘要 对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，源于社会遵从压力。历史案例包括欧洲的决斗传统与中国缠足习俗；当代案例则涵盖女性割礼与炫耀性消费。此类规范呈现出多元演变特征：有的在延续数百年后骤然瓦解，有的逐步消解，还有的则在崩溃前经历渐进升级过程。本文构建的理论框架通过阐释社会影响力的不同作用机制来解释上述模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在缓解或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时揭示某些干预措施可能适得其反。

title: The dynamics of costly norms
title_zh: 昂贵规范的形成机制

journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Do Prior Residents Benefit from Energy Booms?
title_zh: 先期居民是否从能源繁荣中受益？

abstract: This paper investigates whether healthcare access affects educational achievement, exploiting the staggered ACA Medicaid expansion. Using county-level panel data on ACT scores, insurance coverage, and health indicators for 2012–2024, I find that Medicaid expansion raised county-level ACT composite scores by 0.50 to 0.85 points (about 0.22 standard deviations in the controlled specification). A Callaway and Sant’anna heterogeneity-robust estimator yields a simple aggregated ATT of 0.79, indicating the result is not an artefact of forbidden comparisons, and an event study is consistent with parallel pre-trends, with effects building to approximately 1.3 points by 6 years that I read as a suggestive long-run trajectory. The estimate attenuates and loses significance under within-region and within-division comparison and under relative-magnitude pre-trend violations, so I interpret it as suggestive of a causal effect under the design’s identifying assumptions rather than a firmly established magnitude. A supplementary instrumental-variables specification is consistent in sign but imprecise. A selection test does not detect changes in test participation, and channel analysis finds that observable health and economic indicators do not meaningfully mediate the effect, leaving the mechanism an open question for future research with individual-level data.
abstract_zh: 本文利用《平价医疗法案》下各州分阶段实施的医疗补助扩展政策，探究医疗可及性是否影响教育成就。基于2012–2024年县级面板数据（涵盖ACT成绩、保险覆盖率及健康指标），研究发现医疗补助扩展使县级ACT综合成绩提升0.50至0.85分（在控制规范中约为0.22个标准差）。采用Callaway与Sant'anna提出的异质性稳健估计量，得到简单汇总的平均处理效应（ATT）为0.79，表明该结果并非由禁止性比较造成的人为现象；事件研究支持平行趋势假设，且效应在6年内累积至约1.3分，可视为长期趋势的提示性证据。在区域内部及分区内部比较中，以及相对幅度事前趋势违反条件下，估计值减弱并失去显著性，因此本文将其解读为在设计识别假设下具有因果效应的提示性证据，而非确凿的效应量级。辅助工具变量估计在符号上一致但精度不足。选择检验未发现考试参与率变化，渠道分析表明可观测的健康与经济指标并未显著中介该效应，其作用机制有待未来基于个体层面数据的研究进一步探索。
title: Healthcare access and human capital: evidence from Medicaid expansion
title_zh: 医疗可及性与人力资本：来自医疗补助扩展的证据

abstract: Abstract How does district magnitude affect the quality of political representation? The Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) predicts that majority decisions improve with group size when members vote independently and are more likely than not to be correct. We test whether this aggregation mechanism applies to political decisions by examining whether larger legislative delegations better reflect constituent preferences. Nominal district magnitude often overstates the number of independent decision-makers because of party discipline. We therefore introduce effective district magnitude as a measure that more accurately captures the number of independently voting politicians within a constituency. Using 263 Swiss referenda (1992–2024) matched to parliamentary decisions, we find that the probability that a majority of a district’s delegation aligns with the preferences of its constituents increases with (effective) district magnitude, consistent with the CJT. The CJT aggregation mechanism closely predicts delegation-constituency congruence only for effective, not nominal, district magnitude. Our results provide empirical evidence that the CJT applies to representative democracies. They also show how party discipline limits the advantages of larger districts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 选区规模如何影响政治代表质量？孔多塞陪审团定理（CJT）预测，当成员独立投票且正确概率超过一半时，多数决策质量随群体规模提升。本文通过考察较大立法代表团是否更能反映选民偏好，检验这一聚合机制是否适用于政治决策。由于政党纪律约束，名义选区规模往往高估独立决策者数量。为此，我们引入有效选区规模这一指标，更精确地衡量选区内独立投票的政治家数量。基于1992-2024年263项瑞士公投与议会决策的匹配数据，我们发现选区代表团多数意见与选民偏好一致的概率随（有效）选区规模增加而上升，这与CJT预测相符。CJT聚合机制仅对有效选区规模（而非名义选区规模）能精准预测代表团与选民的契合度。本研究为CJT适用于代议制民主提供了实证证据，同时揭示了政党纪律如何限制大选区优势。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Party discipline, representation, and the condorcet jury theorem
title_zh: 党纪、代表性与孔多塞陪审团定理

title: Estimating exact efficiency in multi-weight spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models
title_zh: 多权重空间自回归随机前沿模型中精确效率的估计

abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: PFAS contamination disclosures and declining residential land prices in polluted areas of Japan
title_zh: PFAS污染披露与日本污染地区住宅用地价格下跌

title: Southern roots abroad: The long-run impact of the Confederate migration to Brazil
title_zh: 海外南方根源：美国邦联移民巴西的长期影响

abstract: This study examines the impact of exogenous institutional shocks on economic development by investigating the establishment of treaty ports in late Qing China (1840–1910). Forced open under unequal treaties imposed by foreign powers, these ports provide a quasi-natural experiment to identify the causal effects of openness on industrialization. We construct a novel county-level panel dataset from multiple historical archives, covering 1,752 counties with information on treaty port status, firm establishments, and firm scale measured by capital investment and industrial employment. Employing a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, we find that treaty port establishment significantly promoted firm agglomeration, as well as capital and labour accumulation. Mechanism analysis suggests that treaty ports spurred industrialization by expanding international trade, strengthening institutional control through foreign concessions, and building human capital through new-style schools. Heterogeneity analysis reveals stronger effects in light industries, for firms with foreign and private capital, and in coastal ports. Our findings suggest that treaty ports created the institutional and commercial gateways through which modern industry entered China.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察晚清时期（1840–1910年）通商口岸的设立，探讨外生制度冲击对经济发展的影响。这些口岸在外国列强强加的不平等条约下被迫开放，为识别开放对工业化的因果效应提供了准自然实验。我们基于多个历史档案构建了一个全新的县级面板数据集，涵盖1752个县，包含通商口岸状态、企业设立情况以及以资本投资和工业就业衡量的企业规模等信息。采用交错双重差分法，我们发现通商口岸的设立显著促进了企业集聚以及资本和劳动力的积累。机制分析表明，通商口岸通过扩大国际贸易、通过外国租界加强制度控制以及通过新式学堂积累人力资本，推动了工业化进程。异质性分析显示，通商口岸对轻工业、外资和私营企业以及沿海口岸的影响更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，通商口岸创造了制度与商业门户，现代工业正是通过这些门户进入中国。

abstract: ABSTRACT We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在政治经济学框架下探讨社会地位关注对再分配、收入不平等及经济增长的影响。此类关注的显著性会引发一种传导机制，其中初始收入不平等与再分配意愿的降低相互强化，可能形成多重稳态。扩展分析表明，高再分配与低不平等并存的稳态可能导致更高的稳态收入水平。模型的部分特征与社会地位态度调查数据所反映的实证规律具有一致性。
title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
title_zh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配

abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
title: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility

abstract: ABSTRACT The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。

abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政政策反应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释，该框架认为债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。
title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性

abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pensions as a long-term investor group implies financing costs are less sensitive to new debt issues, but more sensitive to global uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 养老金部门是全球金融市场中的重要投资者群体，也是政府和公司债务的主要持有者。本文研究了全球范围内养老基金资产配置的演变，并记录了两个重要的结构性变化。首先，养老金投资者已将投资组合份额从固定收益证券中转移出来。这一趋势在固定缴款（DC）和固定收益（DB）计划以及不同国家组中均表现稳健。其次，养老金转而将资金配置到共同基金中风险更高的投资以及另类投资中。我们假设全球利率下降是这一变化的潜在驱动因素之一。利用全球样本，我们表明本币政府债券收益率的下降与养老金投资组合中债券份额的降低以及共同基金和外国资产持有份额的增加相关。我们讨论了这些趋势对借贷成本的潜在影响。作为长期投资者群体，养老金持有份额的下降意味着融资成本对新债务发行的敏感度降低，但对全球不确定性的敏感度增加。
authors: Karen K. Lewis; Xiang FANG; Bryan Hardy
title: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets

abstract: This study examines how negative performance feedback is associated with real earnings management (REM) and how firm-level market power conditions that relationship. Building on the behavioural theory of the firm and threat-rigidity theory, we argue that performance shortfalls direct organizational attention towards responses that are immediate, proximate, and risk-acceptable. REM fits this behavioural profile because it can alter reported outcomes through real operating decisions while remaining less directly visible than many accounting choices or illegal actions. Using 23,629 firm-year observations for publicly listed U.S. firms from 1992 to 2018, we find that larger performance shortfalls are associated with higher REM. We also find that this relationship weakens as market power increases. Additional analyses support a cautious interpretation: the evidence is more consistent with shortfall-driven opportunistic REM than with a purely strategic or efficiency-enhancing explanation, although standard REM proxies do not directly identify managerial intent. The findings contribute to applied research on firm behaviour under performance pressure by showing that market power can alter the way firms respond to adverse feedback through real operating decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了负面绩效反馈如何影响真实盈余管理（REM），以及企业层面的市场势力如何调节这一关系。基于企业行为理论与威胁-刚性理论，我们提出：绩效缺口会将组织注意力导向即时、直接且风险可接受的应对措施。真实盈余管理符合这一行为特征——它通过实际经营决策改变报告业绩，同时相较于诸多会计选择或违法行为具有更低的直接可见性。基于1992年至2018年间美国上市公司23,629个公司-年度观测值，本研究发现：绩效缺口越大，真实盈余管理程度越高；市场势力越强，该正向关联越弱。进一步分析支持审慎解读：证据更倾向于表明绩效缺口驱动机会主义型真实盈余管理，而非纯粹战略或效率提升型解释——尽管标准真实盈余管理代理变量无法直接识别管理层意图。本研究通过揭示市场势力如何改变企业通过实际经营决策应对负面反馈的方式，为绩效压力下企业行为的应用研究提供了新见解。
title: The inconvenient truth of problemistic search: real earnings management
title_zh: 问题搜索的不便真相：真实盈余管理

abstract: Bilateral investment treaties (BITs) are widely acknowledged as instruments for attracting inward foreign direct investment (IFDI), yet their effectiveness remains contested. By using a sample of 64 countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, this study employs the Quadratic Assignment Procedure to analyse the impact of BITs on IFDI and further explores how these effects vary across IFDI subnetworks with distinct structural characteristics. Our analysis yields three key findings. First, the effect of BITs on IFDI declined over time – it was strong between 2012 and 2016 but weakened after 2017 due to the emergence of alternative institutions and evolving geopolitical factors. Second, the impact of formal BIT protections is prominent in low-cohesion networks. However, in high-cohesion systems, densely connected networks rely more on informal enforcement mechanisms. Third, strong expropriation clauses enhance investment, whereas investor-state dispute settlement provisions have a limited effect. These results indicate that policymakers should pursue targeted BIT strategies, prioritizing partners with central network positions or those embedded in highly active, low-cohesion communities; furthermore, a pronounced focus on strengthening substantive protections over indiscriminate treaty expansion is suggested. By linking clause-level treaty designs to network characteristics, this study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of heterogeneous IFDI outcomes.
abstract_zh: 双边投资条约（BITs）被广泛视为吸引外商直接投资（IFDI）的工具，但其有效性仍存争议。本研究以"一带一路"倡议沿线64个国家为样本，采用二次指派程序分析BITs对IFDI的影响，并进一步探讨这些效应如何随具有不同结构特征的IFDI子网络而变化。分析得出三项关键发现：第一，BITs对IFDI的影响随时间递减——2012年至2016年间效应显著，但2017年后因替代性制度兴起及地缘政治因素演变而减弱；第二，正式BIT保护机制在低凝聚力网络中作用突出，但在高凝聚力系统中，密集关联网络更依赖非正式执行机制；第三，强有力的征收条款能促进投资，而投资者-国家争端解决条款效果有限。这些结果表明，政策制定者应采取针对性BIT策略，优先选择处于网络中心位置或嵌入高活跃度、低凝聚力社群中的伙伴国；同时建议重点强化实质性保护条款而非盲目扩大条约范围。通过将条款级条约设计与网络特征相联系，本研究有助于更细致地理解IFDI的异质性结果。
title: Connecting the dots: how bilateral investment treaty networks influence inward foreign direct investment
title_zh: 连接点：双边投资条约网络如何影响内向外国直接投资

abstract: This study develops a global stochastic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to evaluate trigger mechanisms and coverage rates for an international joint grain reserve among China, Japan, and South Korea. Framing the reserve as a cooperative risk-sharing institution with public-good characteristics, it links release-rule design to incentive compatibility and institutional sustainability. Unlike prior studies emphasizing reserve size and contribution rules, we examine how release triggers interact with probabilistic shock distributions. We compare VaR-based triggers at 70–95% confidence levels with uniform thresholds of 2.5–20% under 500 correlated productivity-shock paths. Results show that VaR-based triggers generate consistent welfare gains, risk reduction, and complete Pareto improvements. Uniform triggers produce more asymmetric outcomes; at the 10% threshold, Japan and South Korea benefit while China incurs welfare losses. For VaR designs, the optimal coverage rate is approximately 75%, since increasing coverage to 100% brings only marginal additional gains. Excessively aggressive trigger–coverage combinations can weaken performance by accelerating reserve depletion under extreme shocks. Overall, an 80% VaR trigger with 75–100% coverage provides the strongest stabilization effect and more balanced welfare distribution, supporting voluntary participation and long-term cooperation
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个全球随机可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，以评估中日韩三国国际联合粮食储备的触发机制与覆盖率。通过将粮食储备界定为具有公共品属性的合作型风险分担制度，本研究将释放规则设计与激励相容性及制度可持续性相关联。与以往侧重储备规模与出资规则的研究不同，我们重点考察释放触发机制如何与概率性冲击分布相互作用。在500条关联生产率冲击路径下，我们比较了置信水平70%-95%的VaR触发机制与2.5%-20%的统一阈值触发机制。结果表明：VaR触发机制能产生持续福利改善、风险降低及完全帕累托改进；统一阈值触发机制则呈现更显著的非对称效应——在10%阈值下，日韩两国获益而中国遭受福利损失。就VaR设计而言，最优覆盖率约为75%，因将覆盖率提升至100%仅带来边际增益。过度激进的触发-覆盖率组合可能因极端冲击下加速储备消耗而削弱绩效。总体而言，80% VaR触发机制配合75%-100%覆盖率能实现最强稳定效应与更均衡的福利分配，从而支撑自愿参与与长期合作。

abstract: We introduce a new family of power indices for nodes in graphs with classes. We provide an axiomatic characterization of this family and prove the independence of the axioms. Furthermore, we show that these indices coincide with the Shapley values of a family of subadditive transferable-utility games defined on such graphs. These normative results yield a general framework for quantifying structural influence in complex networks. In particular, we identify the normative conditions under which power in technological sharing networks can be represented by our family of indices. Importantly, the proposed axiomatic framework also applies to influence flows that generate negative effects.
abstract_zh: 我们针对带有类别属性的图节点引入了一类新的权力指数族，给出了该指数族的公理化刻画，并证明了各公理之间的独立性。进一步地，我们证明这些指数与定义在此类图上的次可加可转移效用博弈族中的沙普利值一致。这些规范性结论为量化复杂网络中的结构性影响提供了通用框架。特别地，我们识别出技术共享网络中权力可由本指数族表征的规范性条件。重要的是，所提出的公理化框架同样适用于产生负效应的影响力流动。
title: Power in graphs with classes
title_zh: 具有类别的图中的权力

abstract: In dynamic multisector economies, the planner’s optimal capital allocation can serve to minimize the aggregate impact of shocks cascading through nonlinear production networks. We show analytically in a simplified model that, under complementarity and if risk aversion is not too low, (i) optimal capital allocation under uncertainty involves deliberately over-investing, relative to the deterministic optimum, in upstream sectors in order to mitigate severe economic downturns; (ii) this strategy can reduce the average level of consumption and give rise to a high welfare cost of business cycles. Deploying novel deep-learning techniques in a general environment, we show quantitatively that: (iii) the ergodic distribution of the simulated nonlinear economy features higher mean capital levels in key upstream sectors, lower mean levels of macroeconomic aggregates, realistic aggregate volatility, and a welfare cost of business cycles two orders of magnitude larger than in standard one-sector models.
abstract_zh: 在动态多部门经济中，规划者的最优资本配置能够最小化通过非线性生产网络级联放大的冲击对总体经济的影响。我们在简化模型中通过解析推导表明，在要素互补性且风险厌恶程度不太低的情况下：（i）不确定性下的最优资本配置策略会相对于确定性最优状态，有意对上游部门进行过度投资，以缓解严重的经济衰退；（ii）该策略可能降低平均消费水平，并导致商业周期产生高昂的福利成本。通过运用新型深度学习技术于一般化环境，我们定量分析发现：（iii）模拟非线性经济的遍历分布呈现关键上游部门平均资本水平更高、宏观经济总量均值更低、总体波动率符合现实特征，且商业周期福利成本比标准单部门模型高出两个数量级。
title: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
title_zh: 动态生产网络中的灾害应对规划

abstract: Cross-cultural databases are bounded by expert coding and missing observations. The Ethnographic Atlas (EA) codes 1,265 societies on 104 variables, with about 960 societies observed per variable on average, and the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample (SCCS) codes 186 societies on 1,717 variables, with about 105 observed per variable. I use a large language model and the 2,564-motif Berezkin catalogue to extract coverage, what motifs discuss, and stance, what positions they take. Stance, what a motif says, is strongest. Across 26 researcher-designed dimensions, stance is multidimensional (leading component 15.1%, matching ethnographic data) and largely independent of the coverage complexity gradient. On the two dimensions with direct human benchmarks, stance agrees on whether challenged characters succeed (kappa = 0.64) and whether antisocial behavior succeeds or is punished (kappa = 0.49), near the strongest available human benchmark of kappa about 0.57. Among 20 dimensions with no database equivalent, 18 have reliable group-level stance ratios across three runs (ICC >= 0.5$). Nine stance-outcome links survive continent fixed effects, false-discovery correction, and a complexity control, led by outsiders contact for lower GDP and emotional expression for higher female labor participation. Coverage succeeds differently. Across 1,805 usable codebook concepts, coverage predicts 65 of 88 EA variables and detects signal in 35 of 46 pooled SCCS domains, but this information concentrates in one factor. The first principal component explains 43% of score variance versus 15% in EA data, and the resulting complexity index predicts GDP within continents (R^2 = 0.55). Folklore measurement is one-dimensional only when the question is coverage. Researcher-defined concepts become measurable across 958 societies for $0.03 to $1.70.
abstract_zh: 跨文化数据库受限于专家编码与观测缺失。《民族志图谱》（EA）对1265个社会的104个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约960个观测值；《标准跨文化样本》（SCCS）对186个社会的1717个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约105个观测值。我利用大语言模型与包含2564个母题的别列兹金目录，提取了覆盖范围（即母题讨论的内容）与立场（即母题所持的立场）。其中，立场（即母题表述的内容）最为显著。在26个研究者设计的维度中，立场呈现多维性（主成分解释方差15.1%，与民族志数据匹配），且基本独立于覆盖范围的复杂度梯度。在具有直接人类基准的两个维度上，立场在受挑战角色是否成功（kappa=0.64）以及反社会行为是否成功或受惩罚（kappa=0.49）上达成一致，接近现有最强人类基准（kappa约0.57）。在20个无数据库对应维度的维度中，18个维度在三次运行中具有可靠的群体层面立场比率（ICC≥0.5）。九个立场-结果关联在控制大陆固定效应、错误发现率校正及复杂度控制后依然显著，其中外部接触与较低GDP、情感表达与较高女性劳动参与率关联最强。覆盖范围则以不同方式发挥作用。在1805个可用编码手册概念中，覆盖范围预测了88个EA变量中的65个，并在46个合并SCCS领域中的35个中检测到信号，但这一信息集中于单一因子。第一主成分解释43%的得分方差（EA数据中为15%），由此产生的复杂度指数可预测大陆内部的GDP（R²=0.55）。只有当问题聚焦于覆盖范围时，民俗测量才呈现单维性。研究者定义的概念可在958个社会中以0.03至1.70美元的成本实现可测量性。
